integrity: Exact polynomial harmonic equations checked for all twelve transient states; proof uses almost-sure consensus reachability for gamma>0. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a complete three-agent graph, no bots, homogeneous initial intolerance with two A opinions and one B opinion, independent continuous-time layer clocks and 0<gamma<=1; not to gamma=0 or other joint update conventions. Unindexed literature-overlap risk persists.
title: Endogenous majority amplification in a three-agent bi-layer voter process
